title: Wien displacement peak wavelength
prompt: Implement `wien_peak_um(T_kelvin)` returning λ_max in micrometers using b=2897.771955 μm·K.
test_source:
import solution

def run():
    lam=solution.wien_peak_um(5800.0)
    assert abs(lam-2897.771955/5800.0)<1e-9
    assert solution.wien_peak_um(3000.0)>lam
